doc.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Marriage to a musician and not worrying about money
summary: Both Chirillo and his wife are musicians; he has never worried about making ends meet.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well your wife is also a musician.
So you guys are, you’re a pair of musicians, which can be —

It can be. But you know it’s really, if you just like keep doing it long enough then eventually you know enough people and enough things just always, you always end up getting enough to make ends meet. I’ve never really worried about it, ever.
